level_one.title: Once Again the First Time
level_one.description: Quest: Hit 20 Heroes with Sand Blast from Chromie or her Echoes without dying.  Reward: Increase the maximum number of active Echoes to 2, and increase Echo damage to 50%.

level_four.title: Time Troubles
level_four.description: After its Time Stop ends, enemies affected by Time Trap lose 15 Armor for 3 seconds and allies gain 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: A Proper Greeting
level_seven.description: Damaging a Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemy Hero grants 20% additional damage for 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Slowing Sands
level_ten.description: Summon a sand vortex that Slows enemies by 10% every 0.25 seconds, up to 70%.

level_thirteen.title: Time Out
level_thirteen.description: Activate to place Chromie in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for up to 5 seconds. Can be reactivated to end the effect early.

level_sixteen.title: Shifting Sands
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Chromie's primary Sand Blast grants 5% Spell Power for 8 seconds, up to a maximum of 50%. The duration is refreshed whenever an enemy is damaged by the primary Sand Blast.

level_twenty.title: Piercing Sands
level_twenty.description: Sand Blasts cast from Chromie and her Echoes now pierce all enemies hit.

level_one.title: Give 'em the Axe!
level_one.description: Attacking a Hero that is Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed increases Muradin's Basic Attack damage by 40% for 3 seconds.

level_four.title: Reverberation
level_four.description: Increases the Attack Speed Slow of Thunder Clap from 30% to 50% and the duration from 2.5 seconds to 3.5 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

level_seven.title: Heavy Impact
level_seven.description: Enemies hit by Dwarf Toss are Slowed by 80% for 1.5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Avatar
level_ten.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Bronzebeard Rage
level_thirteen.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and heal for 75% of the damage dealt. Hitting an enemy Hero with Storm Bolt increase this damage by 200% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Dwarf Launch
level_sixteen.description: Increase the range of Dwarf Toss by 30%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Dwarf Toss reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Mountain King
level_twenty.description: Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss each gain a 2nd charge.

level_one.title: Unrelenting Torment
level_one.description: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

level_four.title: Haunting Arrows
level_four.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Lost Soul
level_seven.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes and Structures with 3 stacks of Black Arrows reduce the cooldown of Shadow Dagger by 0.75 seconds, doubled against Heroes.

level_ten.title: Wailing Arrow
level_ten.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

level_thirteen.title: Remorseless
level_thirteen.description: Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Black Arrows.  Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1.

level_sixteen.title: Evasive Fire
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy with Withering Fire grants 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%. Basic Attacks refresh this duration.

level_twenty.title: Withering Barrage
level_twenty.description: Withering Fire applies Black Arrows, and Heroes hit by Withering Fire reduce its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level_one.title: Greater Polymorph
level_one.description: Passive: Increase Polymorph's range by 30%.  If Brightwing hits an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center within 2 seconds of being Polymorphed, then reduce Polymorph's cooldown by 7 seconds and gain 50 Mana.

level_four.title: Magic Spit
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Critical Mist
level_seven.description: Soothing Mist heals allied Heroes for 165 (+4% per level). Increase this healing by 140% if Soothing Mist removed a disabling effect from that ally.

level_ten.title: Blink Heal
level_ten.description: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Pixie Boost
level_thirteen.description: Increase Pixie Dust's Movement Speed bonus to 50%, decaying to 20% over 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Critterize
level_sixteen.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

level_twenty.title: Invisible Friends
level_twenty.description: Blink Heal grants Stealth to Brightwing and her Heroic targets for 9 seconds, and they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. While Stealthed by Invisible Friends, Heroes heal for 25 (+4% per level) health per second.  Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

level_one.title: Engulfing Flame
level_one.description: Increase Blast Wave's damage by 50% and its radius by 15%.

level_four.title: Slow Burn
level_four.description: Blast Wave Slows enemies hit by 40% for 2 seconds.

level_seven.title: Blistering Attacks
level_seven.description: Every 10 seconds, Ragnaros's next Basic Attack against a Hero deals 60% bonus damage. Hitting enemies with Basic Abilities reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

level_ten.title: Lava Wave
level_ten.description: Release a wave of lava from Ragnaros's Core that travels down the targeted lane, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage per second to non-Structure enemies in its path and instantly killing enemy Minions. Damage increased by 100% versus Heroes.

level_thirteen.title: Tempered Flame
level_thirteen.description: When Blast Wave damages an enemy Hero, gain a Shield equal to 100% of the damage dealt for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Blast Echo
level_sixteen.description: After Blast Wave explodes, another Blast Wave is created on Ragnaros.

level_twenty.title: Lava Surge
level_twenty.description: Lava Wave gains an additional charge and causes allied Minions and non-Boss Mercenaries to be carried with it.

level_one.title: Growing Nightmare
level_one.description: Increase Dread's damage by 50%.  Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single cast of Dread's eruption.  Reward: Permanently increase Dread's eruption damage by 50% and increase the Slow amount of Dread's eruption by 15%.

level_four.title: Chaotic Assault
level_four.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes while having 3 stacks of Chaos deal an additional 75% bonus damage.

level_seven.title: Mind Devourer
level_seven.description: Quest: Hitting Heroes with Dread increases its damage by 5, up to 150.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, hitting an enemy Hero with Dread's eruption sets its cooldown to 6 seconds and refunds 50 Mana.

level_ten.title: Crushing Jaws
level_ten.description: After 1.25 seconds, pull enemies in an area towards the center, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Abyssal Symbiosis
level_thirteen.description: Hitting a Hero with Chomp instantly grants Orphea maximum Chaos and a 170 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Bond of Anguish
level_sixteen.description: Shadow Waltz deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 3% of their maximum Health, healing Orphea for 50% of damage dealt.

level_twenty.title: Engulfing Oblivion
level_twenty.description: Crushing Jaws reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 50 for 3 seconds. Takedowns set its cooldown to 5 seconds.

level_one.title: Enduring Swarm
level_one.description: Dark Swarm's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds and grants 50 Spell Armor while active.

level_four.title: Hero Stalker
level_four.description: Increases Essence gained from Takedowns by 100%, and gain 1 Essence for each enemy Hero hit by Dark Swarm, up to 3 at once.

level_seven.title: Symbiosis
level_seven.description: Every time Dark Swarm damages an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 0.4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Adaptation
level_ten.description: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.

level_thirteen.title: Primal Swarm
level_thirteen.description: Dark Swarm causes enemies hit to lose 10 Armor for 0.75 seconds, causing them to take 10% extra damage.

level_sixteen.title: Tunneling Claws
level_sixteen.description: Increase movement speed while Burrowing to 120%.

level_twenty.title: Change Is Survival
level_twenty.description: Increases Adaptation healing to 200% of the damage received and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

level_one.title: Prog Rock
level_one.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe permanently increases the healing per second of Guitar Solo by 5, to a maximum of 100  Reward: After gathering 20 Regeneration Globes, Guitar Solo also heals nearby allied Heroes for 50 (+4% per level) Health every second while it is active.

level_four.title: Loud Speakers
level_four.description: Increases Face Melt range and knockback by 50%.

level_seven.title: Echo Pedal
level_seven.description: Using a Basic or Heroic Ability releases two pulses of 18 (+4% per level) damage. This deals 200% bonus damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. The first occurs instantly, the second occurs 2 seconds later.

level_ten.title: Mosh Pit
level_ten.description: After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Encore
level_thirteen.description: Face Melt leaves an Amp behind, which will knock enemies away again 2 seconds later.  Passive: Each enemy Hero hit by Face Melt or the Amp reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 4%.

level_sixteen.title: Show Stopper
level_sixteen.description: After using Powerslide, gain 35 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing all damage taken by 35%.

level_twenty.title: Tour Bus
level_twenty.description: Channeling Mosh Pit refreshes Powerslide's cooldown, and it can be cast to increase Mosh Pit's duration by 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Evenhanded Blessings
level_one.description: If Flash Heal is cast on a different target from its last, increase its healing by 15% and refund 40% of its cooldown.

level_four.title: Piercing Light
level_four.description: Chastise pierces to hit an additional Hero.  Quest: Hitting two Heroes with a single Chastise permanently increases Spell Power by 1, to a maximum of 10.

level_seven.title: Binding Heal
level_seven.description: Casting Flash Heal on an ally heals Anduin for 135 (+4% per level).

level_ten.title: Lightbomb
level_ten.description: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Enchant Boots - Lion's Speed
level_thirteen.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. This bonus is quadrupled while Leap of Faith's cooldown is available. Allies pulled by Leap of Faith are healed for 280 (+4% per level) over 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Glyph of Faith
level_sixteen.description: Leap of Faith gains a 2nd charge.

level_twenty.title: Censure
level_twenty.description: Chastise Stuns for 0.75 seconds and its Root duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Quarterback
level_one.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

level_four.title: Master Assassin
level_four.description: Passive: Increase Tychus's Attack Speed by 10%.  Reward: After getting 15 Takedowns, Tychus's Attack Speed is increased by an additional 15%.

level_seven.title: Melting Point
level_seven.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_ten.title: Commandeer Odin
level_ten.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Neosteel Coating
level_thirteen.description: Activate to gain 75 Spell Armor for 4 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

level_sixteen.title: Titan Grenade
level_sixteen.description: Frag Grenade deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their maximum Health. Each enemy Hero hit by Frag Grenade reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Big Red Button
level_twenty.description: Odin lasts 50% longer and Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile which lands 2.5 seconds later, dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage in its area.
